title: Ten of Me
blurb: A side-view heist in a museum after closing. You get ten runs of thirty seconds, and every run you've played replays beside you as a faded copy doing exactly what you did. Plates hold doors while one of you stands on them, lasers and cameras catch any of you, and guards chase whichever of you they see first, so an old run can be the decoy that drags a guard away from where a later one needs to be.
